texto.@es: Usa **on** con días y fechas: **on Saturday**, **on 12 August**. Para planes decididos, **be going to + verbo**: **I'm going to visit my aunt**. En una invitación, incluye el día o la fecha y la hora: **Would you like to come on 12 August at three?** (¿te gustaría venir el 12 de agosto a las tres?).
texto.@en: Use **on** with days and dates: **on Saturday**, **on 12 August**. For determined plans, **be going to + verbo**: **I'm going to visit my aunt**. In an invitation, include the day or date and time: **Would you like to come on 12 August at three?** (would you like to come on August 12 at 3: 00?).

texto.@es: **I'm going to visit my aunt on 12 August.** = Voy a visitar a mi tía el 12 de agosto.
texto.@en: **I'm going to visit my aunt on 12 August.** = I'm going to visit my aunt on August 12.
